question: 5 men and 6 women can do a piece of work in 6 days while 3 men and 5 women can do the same work in 9 days. In how many days can 3 men and 2 women do the same work?
solution:
Concept: 

M1 D1 = M2 D2

Calculation:

(5M + 6B) × 6 = (3M + 5W) × 9

⇒ 30M + 36B = 27M + 45W

⇒ 3M = 9W

⇒ M : W = 3 : 1

Now, (5M + 6W) × 6 = (3M + 2W) × Days

⇒ (5 × 3 + 6 × 1) × 6 = (3 × 3 + 2 × 1) × Days

⇒ (15 + 6) × 6 = (9 + 2) × Days

⇒ 21 × 6 = 11 × Days

⇒ 126/11 = Days

⇒ Days = 11 (5)/({11)}days

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
